lines.en: label dormwar3:
I dream of something peculiar.
lines.zh: 我梦见了一件离奇的事。

lines.en: A sea of flowers sprawls out across a graveyard on the far reaches of a familiar place under a less than familiar sky.
lines.zh: 一片花海在某个熟悉之地的尽头铺展开来，覆满了整座墓地，而头顶的天空却并不那么熟悉。

lines.en: As I walk toward the horizon, I notice tangled vines emerging from the ground and wrapping around various tombstones, untouched by humans for quite some time.
lines.zh: 我朝地平线走去，注意到纠缠的藤蔓从地里钻出，缠绕在一块块墓碑上，已经很久没人碰过它们了。

lines.en: Though the same can not be said for the touch of time.
lines.zh: 不过，时间的触碰倒是丝毫没有放过它们。

lines.en: Edges of graves that may have once been sharp have been eroded by the weather and its incessant desire to switch from summer to winter in the blink of an eye.
lines.zh: 那些或许曾经棱角分明的墓碑边缘，早已被风雨侵蚀——天气总在眨眼之间从夏转到冬，乐此不疲。

lines.en: I stop walking for some reason after reaching a grave much larger than the rest.
lines.zh: 不知为何，走到一座比其他都大得多的墓前时，我停下了脚步。

lines.en: I can not make out the names on it, but it feels as if someone very important to me is buried here.
lines.zh: 我看不清上面的名字，但感觉像是有什么对我非常重要的人埋在这里。

lines.en: Or was buried here.
lines.zh: 或者说，曾经埋在这里。

lines.en: I think the important parts of human remains tend to disappear over time, feeding the soil and allowing things like vines to sprawl out as far as the eye can see.
lines.zh: 我想，人身上重要的部分总会随时间消逝，滋养土壤，让藤蔓之类的东西一路蔓延到目光所及的尽头。

lines.en: I thank the remains for their wonderful contribution to painting this wasteland a plethora of beautiful colors.
lines.zh: 我感谢那些遗骸做出的杰出贡献，把这片荒地涂抹成了缤纷美丽的颜色。

lines.en: And then I leave.
lines.zh: 然后我离开了。
: S……sei？……

lines.en: : Sensei...wake up...
lines.zh: : Sensei……醒醒……

lines.en: scene imoutomode1

lines.zh: : Ami？……

lines.en: : Good morning, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 早上好，Sensei……

lines.en: : Or, should I say...onii-chan?
lines.zh: : 或者，我该说……哥哥？

lines.en: : I mean...you can call me whatever you want I guess. But that doesn’t explain why you’re waking me up at...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……你想怎么叫我都行吧。可这解释不了你为什么在这个时候把我叫醒……

lines.en: : What time even is it right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底是几点啊？

lines.en: : It’s only 7:00.
lines.zh: : 才七点而已。

lines.en: : I know you like to sleep later normally, but certain...circumstances meant that I had to wake you up a little earlier than normal.
lines.zh: : 我知道你平时喜欢睡到更晚，但某些……情况让我不得不比平时早一点叫醒你。

lines.en: scene imoutomode2
: But, to make up for it, I cooked you breakfast and brewed you coffee! Isn’t that sweet of me, onii-chan?
lines.zh: : 不过，为了补偿你，我给你做了早餐，还煮了咖啡！我是不是很贴心呀，哥哥？

lines.en: : This is weird.
lines.zh: : 这太奇怪了。

lines.en: : What’s weird about taking care of my big brother?
lines.zh: : 照顾自己的哥哥有什么好奇怪的？

lines.en: : Probably the fact that I am suddenly your big brother and not your [uncle].
lines.zh: : 大概奇怪在我突然成了你的哥哥，而不是你的[uncle]。

lines.en: scene imoutomode3
: It’s part of the contest...
lines.zh: : 这是比赛的一部分啦……

lines.en: : I have to compete with Noriko to show her that I’m the only person fit to take care of you...
lines.zh: : 我得和 Noriko 一较高下，让她知道，只有我才是适合照顾你的人……

lines.en: : And I know it probably sounds a little weird since you’ve always looked at me as a [niece], but...I’m {i}kind of{/i} like a little sister too, right?
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来可能{i}有点{/i}怪，因为你一直把我当成[niece]，但……我也算是个妹妹吧，对不对？

lines.en: : Like we could completely change roles and it wouldn’t be any different at all.
lines.zh: : 就算我们彻底换个身份，也不会有任何不同。

lines.en: : Yeah, if that’s the whole point of the contest, you kind of do have the upper hand.
lines.zh: : 是啊，如果这就是比赛的全部意义，那你确实占了上风。

lines.en: scene imoutomode2
: Right! Which is why I’m sure you’ll pick me no matter what I do.
lines.zh: : 没错！所以不管我做什么，我相信你都会选我。

lines.en: : Lucky for you, all I {i}want{/i} to do is take care of you and make you happy, so doing stuff like bringing you breakfast in bed is no trouble at all.
lines.zh: : 你运气好，我唯一{i}想{/i}做的就是照顾你、让你开心，所以像把早餐端到床上给你这种事，一点都不麻烦。

lines.en: : Now go ahead and eat up! We have lots to do today, onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 来，快吃吧！我们今天还有很多事要做呢，哥哥。

lines.en: scene imoutomode4
: And maybe...lots to do tonight as well?...
lines.zh: : 也许……今晚也有很多事要做呢？……

lines.en: : Ooooh! A secret, suggestive attack this early in the contest?! Ami truly is a force to be reckoned with!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦！比赛才刚开始就使出这种隐秘又暧昧的攻势？！Ami 果然是个不容小觑的对手！

lines.en: scene imoutomode5
: Oh. I guess you two are here as well.
lines.zh: : 哦。看来你们两位也在啊。

lines.en: : This totally isn’t weird or anything.
lines.zh: : 这一点都不奇怪，真的。
: 恶心……

lines.en: : You do remember that you two {i}are{/i} actually related, right?...
lines.zh: : 你应该还记得你们俩{i}是{/i}真的有血缘关系吧？……

lines.en: : If it’s with onii-chan...I don’t care~
lines.zh: : 只要是和哥哥一起……我不在乎~

lines.en: : Don’t mind us, Sensei! Just takin’ notes and makin’ sure nothing weird happens!
lines.zh: : 别管我们，Sensei！我们只是做做笔记，确保不会出什么奇怪的事！

lines.en: : Just feel free livin’ up the fantasy until it’s time for Noriko’s turn.
lines.zh: : 你尽管好好享受这个幻想，直到轮到 Noriko 为止。

lines.en: : Noriko?! Is it my turn?! I’m ready whenever!
lines.zh: : Noriko？！轮到我了吗？！我随时都准备好了！

lines.en: : Stay out there, demon! I’ve barely had any time at all!
lines.zh: : 你在外面待着，恶魔！我才刚有点时间！

lines.en: : Ughhhhh fine! But only because I love you!
lines.zh: : 唔——好吧！但只因为我爱你！

lines.en: scene black
I lean up in bed and slide further away from Uta and Makoto, who have more than likely been taking notes on...how I sleep or something.
lines.zh: 我在床上坐起身，往远离 Uta 和 Makoto 的方向挪了挪——她们之前大概一直在记录……我睡觉的样子什么的。

lines.en: I don’t really know what they were doing before Ami woke me up, but I’m not really in any rush to find out.
lines.zh: 我不太清楚在 Ami 叫醒我之前她们在干什么，但我也并不急着知道。

lines.en: Unless it was something sexual. Then I’d want to find out right away.
lines.zh: 除非是跟性有关的。那我倒想马上知道。

lines.en: But it probably wasn’t so...nevermind, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过大概不是吧……算了，当我没说。

lines.en: scene imoutomode6
I quickly eat the breakfast Ami made for me and finish it off with coffee.
lines.zh: 我三两口吃完 Ami 给我做的早餐，最后用咖啡收尾。

lines.en: Just as always, it was exactly to my liking. But at this point, I don’t really expect anything less of her.
lines.zh: 和往常一样，完全合我的口味。不过到了现在，我也早就不指望她会做得不合口味了。

lines.en: In fact, if she ever made anything that {i}wasn’t{/i} exactly to my liking, I’d take it as a sign of an emergency and quickly rush her to the hospital to make sure she isn’t dying.
lines.zh: 事实上，要是她哪天做出{i}不合{/i}我口味的东西，我会当成紧急情况，赶紧把她送去医院，确认她是不是快死了。

lines.en: Thankfully, she is not dying today.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，她今天没有生命危险。

lines.en: Instead, she’s just clinging to my arm while two of her classmates look on and take notes.
lines.zh: 她只是挽着我的胳膊，而她的两个同学在一旁看着，还做着笔记。

lines.en: Yup, it’s a completely normal morning.
lines.zh: 是啊，这真是个再正常不过的早晨。

lines.en: : You know, onii-chan...it isn’t often that we get to be as close as this in front of others...
lines.zh: : 哥哥你知道吗……我们很少有机会在别人面前这么亲密……

lines.en: : Would you believe me if I told you I was feeling a little...embarrassed?
lines.zh: : 如果我说我现在有点……不好意思，你会信吗？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t. I bet you’re loving this right now.
lines.zh: : 不信。我敢说你现在正享受着呢。

lines.en: scene imoutomode7
: Hehehe~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿~

lines.en: : You’re right...
lines.zh: : 你说对了……

lines.en: : I love my big brother more than anything else in the whole wide world. And I don’t care who knows it.
lines.zh: : 我爱我的哥哥胜过这世上任何东西。而且我不在乎谁知道。

lines.en: : So feel free to wrap your arms around me and pull me close if you want!
lines.zh: : 所以，你想的话尽管张开手臂把我搂紧！

lines.en: : Or just let me cling to you like this.
lines.zh: : 或者就让我这样黏着你也行。

lines.en: : So is this really all this competition is?
lines.zh: : 所以这场比赛真的就只是这样吗？

lines.en: scene imoutomode8
: Mmm...I think so?
lines.zh: : 嗯……应该是吧？

lines.en: : We didn’t really come up with any rules. I’m just supposed to prove that I’m the ideal sister.
lines.zh: : 我们其实没定什么规则。我只是要证明自己是理想的妹妹。

lines.en: : And I know you like time to wake up in the morning, so I can’t really do anything exciting.
lines.zh: : 而且我知道你早上需要时间清醒，所以我也不好做什么刺激的事。

lines.en: : I’ll just sit here with you and be cute and expect you to make the right choice.
lines.zh: : 我就坐在这儿陪着你，负责可爱，然后指望你做出正确的选择。

lines.en: : It’s not like I mind or anything, but...
lines.zh: : 我也不是介意什么的，只是……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 只是什么？

lines.en: : You want me to go the extra mile for you?
lines.zh: : 你想让我为你做得更过分一点？

lines.en: : Objection, that’s-
lines.zh: : 反对，那是——

lines.en: : Shh! I wanna see what this “extra mile” is!
lines.zh: : 嘘！我想看看这个“更过分一点”是什么！

lines.en: : Hey! Isn’t that long enough?
lines.zh: : 喂！时间够长了吧？

lines.en: : How am I supposed to compete if Ami’s going to take up like a whole hour in there?
lines.zh: : 要是 Ami 在里面耗上整整一个小时，我还怎么比啊？

lines.en: : Hmm...it is getting close to the ten minutes we allotted her.
lines.zh: : 嗯……已经快到我们给她的十分钟了。

lines.en: : That’s right...Letting Ami go any longer would mean we’d have to let Noriko do the same.
lines.zh: : 说得对……再让 Ami 继续，就意味着我们也得让 Noriko 一样久。

lines.en: : And the rest of the girls should already be heading to the park for the next contest right now.
lines.zh: : 而且其他女生现在应该已经出发去公园准备下一场比赛了。

lines.en: scene imoutomode9
: Onii-chan...they’re trying to take me away from you...
lines.zh: : 哥哥……她们想把我从你身边带走……

lines.en: : It’s just like at the orphanage...where that mean family wanted to adopt me and use me for all sorts of gross things...but you stepped in and saved me...
lines.zh: : 就像在孤儿院那次一样……那家人很坏，想收养我，拿我做各种恶心的事……是你站出来救了我……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Then...as soon as we became old enough...we went out on our own...
lines.zh: : 然后……我们一到足够的年纪……就独自出去生活了……

lines.en: : And then...after falling asleep in each other’s arms in that cold, broken down house...we realized that we were no normal brother and sister-
lines.zh: : 再后来……在那一间冰冷破旧的房子里，我们相拥着入睡……然后我们意识到，我们并不是普通的兄妹——

lines.en: scene imoutomode10
: Okay, I’ve waited long enough.
lines.zh: : 好了，我等得够久了。

lines.en: : Tell Ami to step down before she gets any further into her backstory or I’ll basically lose before I even have a chance.
lines.zh: : 在 Ami 把身世背景讲得更深之前让她下来，不然我还没机会出手就已经输了。

lines.en: : Good point, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Noriko。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, as soon as she broke out the orphan thing, even {i}I{/i} started to get won over, and I’m not even on her team.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}得说，她一搬出孤儿院那套，连我都开始被说服了，而我甚至不是她那边的。

lines.en: : I didn’t even get to the part with the graveyard yet.
lines.zh: : 我还没讲到墓园那一段呢。

lines.en: : You are absolutely disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真是恶心透了。

lines.en: : Noriko, please step in before this competition gets any more...[incest]uous.
lines.zh: : Noriko，趁这场比赛变得更……[incest]之前，请你上场吧。

lines.en: scene imoutomode11
: I mean, gladly. But isn’t the whole competition conceptually [incest]uous?
lines.zh: : 我当然乐意。不过整场比赛在概念上不就是[incest]吗？

lines.en: : Yes...but you and Sensei aren’t {i}actually{/i} related.
lines.zh: : 是……可你和 Sensei 又没有{i}真正{/i}的血缘关系。

lines.en: : Makoto is desensitized to fake [incest] thanks to all of the porn she watches with her mom and-
lines.zh: : Makoto 对假[incest]早就麻木了，多亏了她和她妈一起看的那堆色情片——

lines.en: scene imoutomode12
: I have never once watched anything like that with my mother!
lines.zh: : 我从来没有和我妈一起看过那种东西！

lines.en: : Whatever you say, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 随你怎么说，Makoto。

lines.en: : Ami! Please leave the room now!
lines.zh: : Ami！请你现在就离开房间！

lines.en: : You already have the advantage in that you got to be the one to wake Sensei up. So Noriko already has to figure out a way to overcome that handicap and-
lines.zh: : 你已经占了优势，因为是你叫醒 Sensei 的。所以 Noriko 还得想办法克服这个不利条件，然后——

lines.en: scene imoutomode13
: Oh, you don’t have to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个你不用担心。

lines.en: : What do you mean? Do you already have a plan on how to counter that?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？你已经想好怎么反制了吗？

lines.en: : Yup! And if Sensei drank all of his coffee, then my counter attack should be kicking in any second now.
lines.zh: : 对！而且如果 Sensei 把咖啡都喝光了，那我的反击应该马上就要起效了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Did...
jump norikoimoutox
label norikoimoutox:
: Did you drug my [uncle]?!
lines.zh: : 你给我[uncle]下药了？！

lines.en: : No, I drugged your onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 不，我下药的对象是你哥哥。

lines.en: : Mwahahaha! The second floor wastes no time in showing everyone how dangerous it can be!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈！二楼一点时间都不浪费，就向大家展示了它有多危险！

lines.en: : I feel kind of dizzy all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 我突然有点头晕……

lines.en: : Ahh! Sensei! Hang on!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sensei！撑住！

lines.en: scene imoutomode14
: What in the world have you done, Noriko?!
lines.zh: : 你到底干了什么，Noriko？！

lines.en: : I just told you what I did.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚已经说了。

lines.en: : If there was a “don’t drug your teacher rule,” I would have gladly followed it. I’m just countering in the only way I could think of.
lines.zh: : 要是有“不许给老师下药”这条规则，我肯定会乐意遵守的。我只是用我能想到的唯一办法反击而已。

lines.en: scene imoutomode14blurry
: I...uhhh...
: He’ll only be out for a couple minutes anyway. And by the time he wakes up, you’ll all be able to see how a {i}real{/i} little sister treats her big bro.
lines.zh: : 反正他也就昏过去几分钟。等他醒来的时候，你们就能见识到{i}真正的{/i}妹妹是怎么对待哥哥的。

lines.en: : This is entirely unacceptable! If that’s how the second floor girls are going to compete, this entire competition is-
lines.zh: : 这完全不能接受！如果二楼的女生打算这么比赛，那整场比赛就——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah. If Sensei thinks it’s so bad, he’ll just pick Ami instead. What’s the big deal?
lines.zh: : 行行行。要是 Sensei 觉得这么糟糕，他选 Ami 不就行了。有什么大不了的？

lines.en: : Ami, be a good girl and wait in the living room like Noriko waited for you.
lines.zh: : Ami，乖一点，去客厅等着，就像 Noriko 刚才等你那样。

lines.en: : She only waited because she knew he’d pass out after drinking his coffee!
lines.zh: : 她肯等，只是因为她知道他喝完咖啡就会昏过去！

lines.en: scene black
scene imoutomode15blurry
: Onii-chan...wake up...
lines.zh: : 哥哥……醒醒……

lines.en: : Onii-chan...
lines.zh: : 哥哥……

lines.en: : Onii-chan...onii-chan...onii-chan...
lines.zh: : 哥哥……哥哥……哥哥……

lines.en: scene imoutomode15
: Good morning~
lines.zh: : 早上好~

lines.en: : Noriko?...
lines.zh: : Noriko？……

lines.en: : Did...you actually drug me?
lines.zh: : 你……真的给我下药了？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about, onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么，哥哥。

lines.en: : You were mumbling in your sleep, so I came in to make sure everything was okay.
lines.zh: : 你在睡梦里嘟囔，所以我进来看看你有没有事。

lines.en: : I was probably mumbling because I was drugged.
lines.zh: : 我会嘟囔，大概是因为我被下药了。

lines.en: scene imoutomode16
: Are you sure you weren’t just having a perverted dream about your little sister?...
lines.zh: : 你确定不是做了关于自己妹妹的变态梦？……

lines.en: : You’re so naughty, onii-chan...
lines.zh: : 哥哥真是坏心眼……

lines.en: : But if it makes you feel any better...
lines.zh: : 不过要是这样能让你好受点……

lines.en: : I had a dream like that too...
lines.zh: : 我也做了那样的梦……

lines.en: : Okay, that’s enough. Noriko, get off the bed-
lines.zh: : 好了，够了。Noriko，从床上下来——

lines.en: : Wait wait wait! We let Ami go the full ten minutes and she said some weird stuff too! You’re being biased toward your floor! I will not stand for it!
lines.zh: : 等等等等！我们让 Ami 说满了整整十分钟，她也说了些奇怪的话！你在偏袒你们楼层！我绝不答应！

lines.en: : Noriko, give him all you’ve got!
lines.zh: : Noriko，使出你的全部本事！

lines.en: : You’re really okay with just sitting back and watching her say things like that?!
lines.zh: : 你真的就这么袖手旁观，看她说出那种话？！

lines.en: : It’s immoral and disgusting and-
lines.zh: : 这既不道德又恶心，而且——

lines.en: : Onii-chan?...Why aren’t you saying anything?
lines.zh: : 哥哥？……你怎么不说话？

lines.en: : Is your mind wandering again?
lines.zh: : 你又在胡思乱想了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Right now, it’s somewhere between being under the influence and potentially ruining at least two different relationships before the first contest is over.
lines.zh: : 是的。此刻我的思绪，介于药效发作，以及在第一场比赛结束前可能毁掉至少两段关系之间。

lines.en: scene black
Noriko giggles and slides herself forward, lightly grinding her lower body against one of my legs...
lines.zh: Noriko 咯咯笑着往前挪了挪，把下半身轻轻在我的一条腿上蹭着……

lines.en: Her voice gets quieter and more seductive.
lines.zh: 她的声音变得更轻，也更撩人。

lines.en: And, in other news, I love the dorm war.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条：我爱死这场宿舍大战了。

lines.en: scene imoutomode17
: You know, onii-chan...Mom and Dad aren’t home right now...
lines.zh: : 哥哥你知道吗……爸爸妈妈现在不在家……

lines.en: : So if you’re worried about ruining things with them...you don’t have to be...
lines.zh: : 所以你要是担心会和他们闹僵……大可不必……

lines.en: : Besides, I see no harm in doing a little...{i}experimenting{/i} with you...
lines.zh: : 再说，我觉得和你做点……小{i}实验{/i}也没什么坏处……

lines.en: : I’m at that age where I’ve been thinking about all sorts of {i}naughty{/i} stuff...and I have no idea what I’m supposed to do about it...
lines.zh: : 我这个年纪，脑子里全是各种{i}下流{/i}的事……可我完全不知道该怎么办……

lines.en: : You’re smart...aren’t you, onii-chan?...
lines.zh: : 哥哥很聪明……对吧？……

lines.en: : Can you teach me how to relieve some of those strange urges I’ve been having?...
lines.zh: : 你能教教我，怎么缓解那些奇怪的冲动吗？……

lines.en: : Hey! What’s going on in there?! Why is the door locked?!
lines.zh: : 喂！里面在搞什么？！门为什么锁上了？！

lines.en: : Noriko, as much as I am enjoying this, we should probably-
lines.zh: : Noriko，虽然我很享受这个，不过我们大概该——

lines.en: : Do it quick? If that’s what you think is best, onii-chan...
lines.zh: : 快点做？如果你觉得这样最好，哥哥……

lines.en: : We can always wait for another day for you to...teach {i}me{/i} things...
lines.zh: : 至于你……教{i}我{/i}那些事，改天也行……

lines.en: scene imoutomode18
: For now...why not let your little sister {i}help you out?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在……何不让你的妹妹{i}帮帮你{/i}呢？……

lines.en: : Noriko! Stop it right now!
lines.zh: : Noriko！马上停下！

lines.en: : Did you seriously get hard for your little sister? Pervert...
lines.zh: : 你真的对自己的妹妹硬了？变态……

lines.en: : Ahh! My eyes!
lines.zh: : 啊！我的眼睛！

lines.en: : I’m not ready!
lines.zh: : 我还没准备好！

lines.en: scene imoutomode19
: Come on! You guys are really killing the mood right now!
lines.zh: : 拜托！你们真是太扫兴了！

lines.en: : Right, onii-chan?!
lines.zh: : 对吧，哥哥？！

lines.en: : Tell them you want some private time with your little sister!
lines.zh: : 告诉他们你想和妹妹单独待一会儿！

lines.en: : I...uhhh...
: Could you two maybe leave the room for like, three minutes?
lines.zh: : 你们俩能不能出去大概三分钟？

lines.en: : Absolutely not! I’m unlocking the door and letting Ami back in.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行！我要开门，让 Ami 进来。

lines.en: : Noriko, get off of Sensei right now. This contest is officially over.
lines.zh: : Noriko，马上从 Sensei 身上下来。这场比赛正式结束。

lines.en: : What’s going on in there?!
lines.zh: : 里面到底在干什么？！

lines.en: : Uhh, nothing! Just some...wholesome brother and sister bonding!
lines.zh: : 呃，没什么！只是一些……健康的兄妹交流！

lines.en: : Noriko totally didn’t try to grab Sensei’s-
lines.zh: : Noriko 绝对没有去抓 Sensei 的——

lines.en: : Glasses! She tried to put his glasses on!
lines.zh: : 眼镜！她只是想给他戴上眼镜！

lines.en: : And...as someone who understands the importance of...vision...I could not allow the contest to proceed!
lines.zh: : 而……作为一个明白……视力……有多重要的人，我不能让比赛继续下去！

lines.en: : Oh. It sounded like something else happened, but I guess Noriko’s smart enough to know her place and not try anything she shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 哦。听起来像是发生了别的事，不过我想 Noriko 应该够聪明，知道自己的分寸，不会做不该做的事。

lines.en: scene imoutomode20
: I’m sorry, onii-chan...it looks like our parents came home earlier than expected...
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，哥哥……看来我们的爸妈回来得比预想的早……

lines.en: : But feel free to dream about me again tonight, okay?
lines.zh: : 不过今晚尽管继续梦见我，好吗？

lines.en: : Maybe I can give you another pair of my panties to help you out?
lines.zh: : 也许我可以再送你一条我的内裤，帮帮你？

lines.en: : Wha-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : {i}Another?!{/i}
: I’m pretty sure it’s just roleplay again, but...
lines.zh: : 我猜这只是在角色扮演，不过……

lines.en: : She kinda drugged him. So I don’t think anything is off the table right now.
lines.zh: : 她毕竟给他下了药。所以我觉得现在什么事都有可能发生。

lines.en: scene black
scene imoutomode21
: So, uhh...that was definitely...one way for this competition to go.
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……这确实是……这场比赛的一种走向。

lines.en: : No matter what happens, I am satisfied with the result.
lines.zh: : 不管结果如何，我对这个结果很满意。

lines.en: : Why did we even let this particular contest happen in the first place? Of course it was going to end like this...
lines.zh: : 我们当初到底为什么要让这场比赛存在？它当然会变成这样收场……

lines.en: : Next time you drug my [uncle], don’t lock me out of the room.
lines.zh: : 下次你给我[uncle]下药时，别把我锁在门外。

lines.en: : {i}Next{/i} time?
scene imoutomode22
: Got it. We’ll share him if I do it again, like good little sisters should.
lines.zh: : 明白了。要是我下次再这么做，我们会分享他的，就像好妹妹该做的那样。

lines.en: : Why is everyone except Makoto so accepting of this? You could have killed me.
lines.zh: : 为什么除了 Makoto 之外所有人都这么能接受？你可是差点害死我。

lines.en: scene imoutomode23
: You look fine to me.
lines.zh: : 我看你挺好的啊。

lines.en: : And your {i}glasses{/i} certainly felt fine, if you don’t mind me saying that.
lines.zh: : 而且你的{i}眼镜{/i}摸起来也很不错，恕我直言。

lines.en: : What does that even mean? Just hurry up and tell me I won so we can move onto the next contest.
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？赶紧宣布我赢了，我们好进行下一场比赛。

lines.en: : Agreed. It pains me to say this, but the sooner we name Ami the victor, the better.
lines.zh: : 同意。虽然说这话让我很痛心，但越快宣布 Ami 获胜越好。

lines.en: scene imoutomode24
: Hey, hold on a sec! Noriko may have played dirty, but she was still a great little sister!
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下！Noriko 也许手段脏了点，但她依然是个很棒的妹妹！

lines.en: : Just imagine wakin’ up to something like that! If you were a boy, you’d be over the moon!
lines.zh: : 想象一下醒来就看到那样的场面！你要是个男的，肯定乐疯了！

lines.en: : She literally {i}drugged{/i} him. And we don’t even know what she gave him or where she got it from.
lines.zh: : 她真的给他{i}下了药{/i}。我们甚至不知道她给他吃了什么、从哪儿弄来的。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. It’s over and done with. Just hurry up and pick a winner, onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。都过去了。赶紧选个赢家吧，哥哥。

lines.en: menu:
Ami wins
lines.zh: Ami 获胜

lines.en: $ imoutoami = True
$ dorm1warpoints += 1
: Well, it probably comes as no surprise, but the winner of the apparent little sister contest is Ami.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这大概一点都不意外，这场所谓的小妹妹比赛的获胜者是 Ami。

lines.en: scene imoutomode25
: Hah! Of course it is.
lines.zh: : 哈！那当然。

lines.en: : True love always prevails. But don’t get so down about it, Noriko. I’ve been practicing for this contest since the moment Sensei took me in.
lines.zh: : 真爱总会获胜。不过别太沮丧，Noriko。从 Sensei 收留我的那一刻起，我就在为这场比赛练习了。

lines.en: : But...I’ve also been kind of like a little sister to you for basically forever.
lines.zh: : 可是……我也差不多一直都像你的妹妹啊。

lines.en: : What did I do wrong?
lines.zh: : 我哪里做错了？

lines.en: : Noriko, you literally drugged me.
lines.zh: : Noriko，你真的给我下了药。

lines.en: scene imoutomode26
: Yeah, there was no way you were going to win after making a move like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你出了那一招，就绝对不可能赢了。

lines.en: : A real little sister thinks about her brother’s health before anything else.
lines.zh: : 真正的妹妹会把哥哥的健康放在第一位。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have had to do that if I had gotten to go first! Just...waking him up was a part of my plan and I knew what I gave him was safe and...yeah.
lines.zh: : 要是让我先上，我才不用那么做呢！只是……叫醒他本来就是我计划的一部分，而且我知道给他的东西是安全的……行了。

lines.en: scene imoutomode27
: This isn’t over, though!
lines.zh: : 不过这事还没完！

lines.en: : Ami may have won the little sister contest, but it would have been completely different if we were fighting over who the better girlfriend would be!
lines.zh: : Ami 也许赢了小妹妹比赛，但如果是比谁更适合当女朋友，结果就完全不同了！

lines.en: : Noriko, I wouldn’t want a girlfriend to drug me either.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我也不希望女朋友给我下药啊。

lines.en: : I’ll remember that!
lines.zh: : 我记住了！

lines.en: scene black
Noriko wins
lines.zh: Noriko 获胜

lines.en: $ imoutonoriko = True
$ dorm2warpoints += 1
: The winner of the apparent little sister contest or whatever this was called...is Noriko.
lines.zh: : 这场所谓的小妹妹比赛——管它叫什么来着——的获胜者……是 Noriko。

lines.en: scene imoutomode28
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Hell yeah!
lines.zh: : 太棒了！

lines.en: : Hell yeah!
lines.zh: : 太棒了！

lines.en: : Are...you fucking insane?
lines.zh: : 你……你他妈疯了吗？

lines.en: : Are you really just overlooking what she did?
lines.zh: : 你真的就这么无视她做过的事？

lines.en: : No. What she did was inexcusable and it’s a miracle she won with that in mind.
lines.zh: : 不。她做的事不可原谅，考虑到这一点，她还能赢简直是个奇迹。

lines.en: scene imoutomode29
: Hey, what kind of victory speech is this? I want to be praised and stuff.
lines.zh: : 喂，这算什么获胜感言啊？我要的是夸奖之类的。

lines.en: : The reason Noriko wins is that she just felt like a more authentic little sister to me.
lines.zh: : Noriko 获胜的原因是，对我来说她更像一个真正的妹妹。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} was your idea of authentic? Roleplay like that is arguably the least authentic thing that exists.
lines.zh: : 那叫“真正的”？{i}那种{/i}角色扮演大概是世界上最不真实的东西了。

lines.en: : It was certainly...a thing. Though, I definitely enjoyed it.
lines.zh: : 那确实是……挺离谱的一件事。不过，我确实很享受。

lines.en: : Same. I would have kept going if we weren’t stopped, too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。要不是被拦下，我还会继续的。

lines.en: : The thing is, Ami’s portion of the contest was just more of...Ami being Ami.
lines.zh: : 问题在于，Ami 那部分比赛，说到底只是……Ami 还是那个 Ami。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But you love me...
lines.zh: : 可你是爱我的啊……

lines.en: : Obviously. But to me, it was like you were just being my [niece] like always and slapping an “onii-chan” sticker on it.
lines.zh: : 当然。但对我来说，那感觉就像你一如既往地当我的[niece]，只不过贴了张“哥哥”的贴纸上去。

lines.en: : But...I had a whole backstory...
lines.zh: : 可是……我可是准备了完整的身世背景……

lines.en: : True, but Noriko actually felt like a different person.
lines.zh: : 没错，但 Noriko 真的让我觉得像换了一个人。

lines.en: : So...I lost because...I’m too good at being your [niece] to be seen as anything else?
lines.zh: : 所以……我输了，是因为……我太擅长当你的[niece]，反而不可能被看成别的什么？

lines.en: : If that’s how you want to rationalize it, sure.
lines.zh: : 你要这么理解的话，随你。

lines.en: : You were both great, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你们俩都很棒。

lines.en: scene imoutomode30
: Well...it feels a little better when you put it like that...but I still don’t like this...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你这么说我还好受一点……但我还是不喜欢这样……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry, Ami. Sensei’s probably always looked at me like a little sister anyway, so my portion of the contest was probably just him living out some fantasy of his.
lines.zh: : 别担心啦，Ami。Sensei 大概一直都把我当妹妹看，所以我那部分比赛，也许只是他把自己的某种幻想给实现了而已。

lines.en: : You know, I can’t say there are any fantasies of mine that involve being drugged.
lines.zh: : 说起来，我还真没有哪个性幻想是被下药的。

lines.en: : I’m sure there will be at least {i}one{/i} after this morning, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我敢肯定，经过今天早上之后，至少会有{i}一个{/i}。

lines.en: : Let’s just...stop talking about this contest altogether and move on...
lines.zh: : 我们就……别再聊这场比赛了，赶紧往前走吧……

lines.en: : I absolutely can not be the only person extremely uncomfortable right now.
lines.zh: : 现在极度不适的人绝对不可能只有我一个。

lines.en: : For once, I actually agree with Makoto.
lines.zh: : 难得一次，我居然真的同意 Makoto。

lines.en: : Let’s just get dressed and...walk to the park...
lines.zh: : 我们换好衣服……走去公园吧……

lines.en: scene black
Makoto and Uta head out before the rest of us so they can relay the results of the match to their teams.
lines.zh: Makoto 和 Uta 先我们一步出发，好把比赛结果带回各自的队伍。

lines.en: I’m ready before Ami and Noriko are, but I still decide to wait for them near the front door so we can all walk to the park together.
lines.zh: 我比 Ami 和 Noriko 先准备好，但我还是决定在前门附近等她们，好让大家一起去公园。

lines.en: I’m sure it would be significantly more awkward if it were just the two of them, so I’m hoping my presence is able to quell some of the unease.
lines.zh: 如果只有她们两个人，气氛肯定会尴尬得多，所以我希望我在场能缓和一点不安。

lines.en: It’s not really easy to just choose between two girls you like, especially when you know how sensitive both of them are.
lines.zh: 在两个你都喜欢的女生之间做选择本来就不容易，尤其当你知道她们俩都很敏感的时候。

lines.en: But it’s still just a game at the end of the day. And I’m sure that the result of this match won’t have any long lasting effects on their relationship.
lines.zh: 但说到底这只是个游戏。我相信这场比赛的结果不会对她们的关系产生什么长远影响。

lines.en: Or my relationship with them, for that matter.
lines.zh: 也不会影响我和她们的关系。

lines.en: They’ll both continue to be head over heels in love with me-
lines.zh: 她们会继续为我神魂颠倒——

lines.en: And I will continue to absorb their feelings until there is nothing left of them.
lines.zh: 而我会继续吸收她们的感情，直到她们什么都不剩。
